items.summary: Dollar Tree and Dollar General shares are bleeding out at a pace several times worse than the broader retail sector, and neither company has said a word to explain it. With the holiday season approaching and core shoppers already strained, the next earnings report could determine whether 2026 gains survive at all.

items.title: Dollar Tree (DLTR) Stock Looks Reasonable With Cash Flow Value Ahead
items.summary: Dollar Tree has delivered a solid share price run, and the question now is whether that move lines up with the cash flows the business is expected to generate. With the stock recently closing at US$131.04, investors are asking how much of the future cash flow story is already reflected in that price.
